meta.battery: Assorted use cases: FS persistence across stop/start, suspend/resume, SSH session creation, API-server fleet surface (36 gateways, 4 clusters, roles), version distribution, sandbox load stats, label round-trip, NOT_FOUND handling.
meta.title: The edge cases: ephemeral FS across restarts, unsupported suspend, fleet stats

results.title: Filesystem persists across stop/start
results.desc: Write file, stop, start, read back
results.detail: write='marker' readback='GONE' — FINDING: kubernetes-driver sandboxes do NOT persist /tmp across stop/start (fresh container on restart); persistence requires the OpenShell workspace layer, not the container FS
steps: ExecSandbox: cat /tmp/persist-test — result: GONE (container FS ephemeral)

results.title: Suspend / Resume lifecycle
results.desc: Suspend, verify state, resume, wait ready
results.detail: suspend grpc=9 state-suspended=False resume grpc=9 ready-again=ready — FINDING: Suspend/Resume returns UNIMPLEMENTED(9) on kubernetes driver (VM-style checkpoint/restore not supported on this backend)
steps: ResumeSandbox RPC — both return UNIMPLEMENTED(9) on kubernetes driver
